title: On Decorating the hall with paper flowers
subtitle: 节日庆典 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 节日庆典（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）
meta: 主题语境：节日庆典（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）　|　核心词汇：decorate　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 decorate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the driver ① decorated the hall with paper flowers without complaint, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the driver ② decorates the hall with paper flowers with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ decorate the hall with paper flowers at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ decorated the hall with paper flowers before — a line in the timetable for February 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Decorating the hall with paper flowers without complaint, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ decorate the eldest son after the war with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Decorate the eldest son after the war at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the timetable, and a new passenger from the next station ⑧ decorates the eldest son after the war without complaint every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the platform, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ decorated the hall with paper flowers again when nobody else would.

⑩ To decorate the hall with paper flowers, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody decorates the hall with paper flowers with great care again and somebody must decorate the hall with paper flowers without complaint all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 装饰（一般过去式 decorated the hall with paper flowers：1989 年司机头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 装饰（一般现在 decorates the hall with paper flowers：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 装饰（不定式 to decorate the hall with paper flowers：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 装饰（过去完成时 had decorated the hall with paper flowers：1983 年二月的时刻表上那行字之前就有人做过）

F. v. 授勋（decorate the eldest son after the war：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去授勋战后给长子授勋）

H. v. 装饰（后段两处：新来的乘客照例 decorates the eldest son after the war，而母亲又一次 decorated the hall with paper flowers）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 decorate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the driver decorated the hall with paper flowers without complaint, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the driver decorates the hall with paper flowers with great care whenever the station asks.
Decorating the hall with paper flowers without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever decorate the eldest son after the war with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new passenger from the next station decorates the eldest son after the war without complaint every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother decorated the hall with paper flowers again, and the station remembered that half.
